free_tier.stated: EUR 95/month for an Intel Xeon E5-2640 v4 in Frankfurt: 10 cores and 20 threads, 64 GB DDR4, 1 TB SAS, a 1 Gbit/s uplink, 200 TB of monthly traffic, 1 IPv4 and a /64 IPv6, DDoS protection, an OS auto-installer and no setup fee, in firstcolo FRA4. Higher rows: EUR 110 for an E5-2620 v4 with 8 cores, 128 GB and 512 GB of NVMe on 10 Gbit/s; EUR 120 for a Ryzen 7 5700X with 8 cores, 64 GB and 1 TB of NVMe; EUR 150 for a Ryzen 9 5950X with 16 cores, 128 GB and 1 TB of NVMe; EUR 160 for either an E5-2680 v4 with 14 cores and 256 GB or a Ryzen 7 9700X with 64 GB DDR5. The thread states the configurations are available for business customers only, and that all listed prices are recurring monthly rental prices in EUR excluding VAT, on one-month contracts paid in advance that renew monthly unless cancelled.

egress.terms: 200 TB a month on every configuration; no overage price and no post-allowance throttle stated
